prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle behind them, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of the stopped car. The impact was consistent with a moderate rear-end collision at low to moderate speed, and the resulting damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assemblies is largely in line with the force described by those involved. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was assessed at the scene before declining transport. A Passenger seated in the front seat of Driver 1's vehicle was also present and was identified as such by responding officers. Driver 2 acknowledged following too closely and did not dispute how the collision occurred. Two independent witnesses on the shoulder provided statements that matched the sequence of events, and scene photographs were taken and placed in the file. Responding officers observed no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and the registered owner was confirmed to be listed on the active policy at the time of the incident.
